generation_mode: User manually copies prompts to ChatGPT web and downloads results; no automated image-generation service is used.
counting_rule: Every separately downloaded image counts as one. A multi-panel board remains one image only when generated and downloaded as one board; it does not grant extra image budget.

status.filename_note: The original 04 and 05 output filenames are retained. The previous 06-12 draft filenames are withdrawn; use only the revised names listed in second_batch.

provenance_policy.generated_content: Original creative illustrations and conceptual art only; record each as original generated material, not as a historical source.
provenance_policy.historical_evidence: Do not generate real news, forum posts, real people records, published manga, known characters, or real platform/software screenshots.
provenance_policy.software_capture: Capture actual ChatGPT work, Blender, Unity, VRChat, and this project's Play flow from the real project. Generated images must not imitate the editor UI.
provenance_policy.reference_assets: Reference video contact sheets are for style analysis only. The scene-block model preview is a structural input for prompt 11's concept art, not evidence of editor use.
provenance_policy.keygen_boundary: No keygen executable, download link, cracking instruction, or protected original application imagery.

items.prompt_section: 04. 同一原创漫画的翻译前后对照
items.animation_use: Hold the original drawing and replace only the dialogue text with the Chinese state.
items.consistency: Generate the original and translated halves from one newly created comic. Lock characters, panels, art, framing, bubble positions, and lighting; change only language.

items.prompt_section: 05. 上传 04 后生成同源清稿与中文版

input_images.role: Only visual and composition reference: the user's generated v2-04-comic-translation-pair.png.

crop_regions: left clean artwork with empty bubbles
right same artwork with Chinese text
items.animation_use: Use the clean panel as the base; reveal Chinese dialogue in the same bubble coordinates.
items.consistency: Edit the uploaded image only. Preserve identity, line art, pose, framing, stars, background, panel geometry, and speech-bubble geometry; remove or replace lettering only.

items.prompt_section: 06. 原创 Flash 风格逐格动画素材板
crop_regions: six sequential animation frames in a 3 by 2 grid
items.animation_use: Crop the six frames and play as a short original 2D animation.
items.consistency: The same small cyan pixel star/light remains the subject through all six states; only its action and surrounding shapes advance.

items.prompt_section: 07. 原创游戏 CG 的对话翻译前后
display_text: この地図は、みんなの道しるべだ。
这张地图，是大家的路标。
items.animation_use: Keep the scene still and replace the dialogue-box language.
items.consistency: Two copies of the same new original CG with identical characters, scenery, pose, lighting, framing, map and dialogue box layout; only dialogue text changes.

items.prompt_section: 08. 有细节的原创个人主页作品页
items.animation_use: Hold the authored central artwork while changing menu highlight, visit count, update status, or small animation accents.
items.consistency: An original designed web artwork, not a reconstruction or screenshot of a real historical site.

items.prompt_section: 09. 原创中文网络反应贴纸
crop_regions: twelve individual sticker cells in a 3 by 4 grid
items.animation_use: Show stickers in staggered small bounces or edge scrolls without covering the historical focus.
items.consistency: Original visual interpretations of example expressions; not reproductions of a real meme image or forum post.

items.prompt_section: 10. 多种互联网文化物件的精细静物画
items.animation_use: Use object cutouts for slow parallax and local light movement; keep objects as parallel activities rather than one chronological narrative.
items.consistency: Original illustrative still life; blank screen and paper contain no fabricated historical text or UI.

items.prompt_section: 11. 以真实模型预览为结构依据的概念稿
items.animation_use: Use as a hand-drawn concept layer before the real Blender/Unity model and its actual expanding Play sequence.
items.consistency: Preserve the source preview's camera, object count, forms, positions, and proportions; do not invent a different world. Never present the edit as a software screenshot.
